pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding volume into a moving sequence when open position unrealized P&L is negative or when ATR exceeds the 20-period moving average by > 1.5x.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated 3-bar structural volume confirmation and an Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) delta > +0.65 prior to executing any directional entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of the position at +$10.00 and trail the remainder with a tight ATR-based structural stop to protect against profit evaporation.
